The hounds stalk our outpost, glass spiders nest to the east, and a sentinel guards the rift beyond.
The hounds stalk our outpost, glass spiders nest to the east, and a sentinel guards the rift beyond. Take my contracts as you clear the basin. The gate behind us returns to Briar Crossing.
The waystone keeps this little refuge quiet.
The waystone keeps this little refuge quiet. Rest here between hunts. If you fall, its light will guide you home with your belongings.
We built around the old road, where the pines give way to briar. Mara keeps our tools sharp; Elric watches the gate. One day these paths may carry caravans again.
A sound edge and a stitched coat go farther than brave words.
A sound edge and a stitched coat go farther than brave words. I buy moss shards and spare gear. What do you need?

Try the Marchguard Sword first, then a Quilted Jack. Keep some shards for Oren and some gold for tonics. At level three, my 240-gold bridle unlocks a horse: use it from your pack, then H to ride. Faster return trips mean more time hunting.
The first temper is guaranteed.

The first temper is guaranteed. Later attempts spend gold and moss even when they fail, but keep your item and its level. Wakeglass can guarantee one uncertain attempt; you still pay the normal cost. Keep it for an upgrade that matters.

Welcome to Briar Crossing.

Welcome to Briar Crossing. The waystone heals you for free. Take Briar at the Gate and follow the north road to Briarwood Verge. Click a mossling to approach and attack; keep the group in front of your blade. You can meet Mara before or after your first hunt.

Old Pine Hollow shelters grown mosslings. Beyond it, the Broken Cairn belongs to ironbacks. A glowing gate north of town leads to Cinderfall Basin; Scout Vela is holding an outpost there. Prepare before crossing.
Then take your time with the ironbacks. Their heavy shells hide valuable old steel. Leave room in your pack before you go.
